title: Differentiation of radial cutoff integrals in the scale parameter
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, μ a Borel measure on E that is finite on compact sets, f: E → ℝ, φ: ℝ → ℝ of class C¹, ξ ∈ E and c, R, A, τ ∈ ℝ with φ(t) = 0 for all t ≥ c, c > 0, τ > 0, cτ < R, f a.e. strongly measurable for μ restricted to B_R(ξ), and |f(x)| ≤ A for all x ∈ B_R(ξ). Then x ↦ f(x)φ(|x − ξ|/τ) and x ↦ f(x)·(−(|x − ξ|/τ²)·φ'(|x − ξ|/τ)) are μ-integrable, and t ↦ ∫ f(x)φ(|x − ξ|/t) dμ(x) has derivative ∫ f(x)·(−(|x − ξ|/τ²)·φ'(|x − ξ|/τ)) dμ(x) at t = τ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (f : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (c R A τ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ t, c ≤ t → φ t = 0) → 0 < c → 0 < τ → c * τ < R → AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |f x| ≤ A) → Integrable (fun x ↦ f x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) μ ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ f x * (-(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ))) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ ∫ x, f x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / t) ∂μ) (∫ x, f x * (-(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) ∂μ) τ
